does.text: Collects dummy entities (AnimationStateComponent + DummyComponent + Visual) that do NOT yet carry IsCopyingFullPoseComponent and that either just had their Visual changed, had their AnimationState modified, or had their equipment VisualsVisibilityState added or modified (four query slots). Each candidate goes through an unread predicate; the survivors are then given IsCopyingFullPoseComponent through the deferred command buffer (the only component the system writes). So the marker appears on a dummy after its visual or animation state changes, i.e. around the time it is posed or re-equipped in photo mode.
